data.name: Hazard Sense
data.description: A wilderness explorer gains an intuitive understanding of natural hazards and traps fashioned from a natural environment. He gains a +%1 bonus on Reflex saves against natural hazards and wilderness traps and a +%1 dodge bonus to AC against attacks from wilderness traps.|RangerLVL/4
